label: D2 after a1 -> S1 (common) when the previous trial was rewarded and value is high
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never D1/GO), and only when the inputs show action a1 with a common transition to S1 (in_action==1 & in_state==1), and only after a rewarded previous trial (prev_reward==1). Within that, it needs the model value head to be high (top ~10% of value, >8.1). That condition stands in for a confident a1/S1-is-good belief and is why the feature goes silent after about episode trial 60 (an ep_trial<55 gate scores F1 0.84 instead of 0.89). It never fires on a2, S2, rare transitions or unrewarded previous trials. All variables are observed at D2 or are model outputs; no future variables are used. In the example windows magnitude tends to be highest in the middle of runs of rewarded a1->S1c trials; raising the value threshold to 8.3 increases precision to 0.96 but lowers recall to 0.87.

issues: The factual claims hold up. Every activation is at D2 (D1 and GO rates are 0). All of the activation mass has in_action==1, in_state==1, common==1 and prev_reward==1. Within the predicate there are only 3 test misses, about 0% of the mass.

The value threshold of 8.1 is set too low. Raising it to 8.2 improves test F1 from 0.889 to 0.922, and 8.25 gives 0.929 (P 0.925, R 0.933). The 8.1 cutoff is a weak choice, not a different explanation.

There is a systematic false-positive class late in the episode. Predicate precision falls from 0.95 at ep_trial<10 and 0.92 at 10-29 to 0.58 at 45-54 and 0.34 at ep_trial>=55. The value threshold does not fully capture the late-episode silence. The explanation mentions this but the predicate does not encode it. Adding ep_trial<55 to the value>8.1 predicate brings dev F1 to 0.902.

There is a small false-positive class when the previous trial was a2 or rare (prev_action==2 / prev_common==0): predicate precision there is only 0.13, but n=641 so the effect is minor. Adding prev_action!=2 raises dev F1 slightly (0.888 -> 0.893).

The claim that value 'stands in for a confident a1/S1-is-good belief' is speculation. Conditioning on the hidden good state instead (good==1) gives F1 0.54 and recall 0.81, so the feature does not track the true good state. Value is a model-internal readout, not an observed variable.
The label is a fair summary of the predicate and does not overclaim. No future variables are used.
skeptic.revised_label: D2 after a1 -> S1 (common) following a rewarded a1 trial, when the value estimate is high (mostly early or mid episode)
